cases.question: What is the main architecture proposed in this paper?
cases.expected_answer_summary: The Transformer — an architecture based entirely on attention mechanisms, with no recurrence or convolutions.

cases.question: What tasks were used to evaluate the model?
cases.expected_answer_summary: Machine translation — WMT 2014 English-to-German and English-to-French translation tasks.

cases.question: What BLEU score did the model achieve on the English-to-German translation task?
What BLEU score did it get on English-to-French?
cases.expected_answer_summary: 41.8 BLEU, a new single-model state-of-the-art result.

cases.question: What is self-attention?
cases.expected_answer_summary: An attention mechanism relating different positions of a single sequence to compute a representation of that sequence.

cases.question: How many layers does the encoder have in the base model?
What is multi-head attention, and why does the model use it instead of a single attention function?
cases.expected_answer_summary: Multiple attention functions run in parallel with different learned projections, letting the model attend to information from different representation subspaces at different positions simultaneously.

cases.question: Since the Transformer has no recurrence, how does it account for the order of words in a sequence?
cases.expected_answer_summary: Positional encodings (sine and cosine functions of different frequencies) are added to the input embeddings.

cases.question: What optimizer was used to train the model?
cases.expected_answer_summary: The Adam optimizer, with a learning rate schedule involving warmup followed by decay.

cases.question: How long did it take to train the base model, and on what hardware?
cases.expected_answer_summary: About 12 hours on 8 NVIDIA P100 GPUs.

cases.question: What regularization techniques did they use during training?
How does that compare to the previous best results?
cases.expected_answer_summary: It improves over previous best results (including ensembles) by over 2 BLEU on English-to-German, and sets a new single-model state-of-the-art on English-to-French.

cases.expected_answer_summary: No — the model relies entirely on attention mechanisms, explicitly avoiding recurrence and convolutions.
